description: Program-check card issues for every preset, no saved baseline, from tools/check_priority.py top(): red then amber (info never shown), score within a state, cap 3, no minimum score. Each issue has its score components, action (apply | see_analysis) and the Apply fix (ops + undo, null for see_analysis). builder_interim = the Builder's interim order (fails, then amber, then biggest gap; info left out) for comparison. A model, not a measurement.
